description: This file defines the 'Scheme' data structure and related functions for validation, serialization, and manipulation within the Mattermost project. It includes constants, struct definitions, methods for YAML marshaling/unmarshaling, validation logic, and role management for schemes.

classes.name: Scheme
classes.description: Represents a scheme with roles and scope, used for permissions and configurations.

classes.name: SchemePatch
classes.description: Partial update structure for Scheme, allowing optional fields.

classes.name: SchemeConveyor
classes.description: Used for importing/exporting schemes and associated roles.

classes.name: SchemeRoles
classes.description: Represents scheme access levels for admin, user, and guest.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of scheme fields for auditing purposes.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Replaces scheme fields with placeholder values.

methods.name: MarshalYAML
methods.description: Serializes the scheme to YAML format.

methods.name: UnmarshalYAML
methods.description: Deserializes YAML data into a Scheme object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the scheme's ID and overall correctness.

methods.name: IsValidForCreate
methods.description: Validates scheme fields for creation, including name, description, scope, and roles.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to update scheme fields.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map for auditing SchemeRoles.

methods.name: IsValidSchemeName
methods.description: Checks if a scheme name matches the required pattern.
